Gideon, I posted the draft here in #strategic-random as a reply to you. It's operational timing only, with no finance content, so it's fine for this channel.

- First report: 10:42 AM, Aug 3. Both gate kiosks showed a white screen after badge scan.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM. Trailer 8836 checked in and dispatch saw it.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM.

One line I added is my inference, not something the channel states: "Gate check-in moved to paper trailer logging." The only source is the guard writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Remove it if you'd rather not say it. I left out the status-page access problem and INC-4821 because they're internal follow-ups, not part of the timeline.
